people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
translations.bsb: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.”
translations.kjv: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan
translations.asv: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.
